triggers.description: Fired when a linked GitHub pull request merges. The merge is the authority, so this transition bypasses the Review gate.

Fired on every Work Item status change (the WORK_ITEM_STATUS_CHANGED event). Lets a lifecycle auto-advance one status to another; honors the Review gate, so a review-gated edge only fires once its Review is satisfied.

Fired when an APPROVED review is recorded on a Work Item. Honors the Review gate — bound to the open review round and the publish bundle, so a stale approval never fires it — and cascades along consecutive edges that declare this same trigger, so a lifecycle can go from 'approved' straight to 'scheduled' on one click. Never fires on a plain status change, which is what keeps a human's Unschedule from re-scheduling.
